sections.Profile:
The Mistress of the Dark is trying to sell her mansion, but it is haunted by monsters from some of the worst films ever made, out for revenge on Elvira. Send them back to the films they came from in the third Elvira pinball, designed by Dennis Nordman with art by Greg Freres and new speech and video scenes recorded by Cassandra Peterson.

- Manufacturer: Stern Pinball Inc.
- Years made: 2019
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
- Display: LCD
- Players: 4
- Tags: Ghosts, 2010s, Licensed, Solid State, Elvira, Pinball Franchise, Horror
